_doc: Upgrades bought at the Upgrade Station. currency 'coins' upgrades RESET on rebirth; 'gems' upgrades are permanent. cost(level) = base * growth^level unless an explicit 'costs' list is given. 'per' is the effect per level.

upgrades.name: Pet Strength
upgrades.desc: +12% damage for all your pets per level.

upgrades.name: Coin Magnet
upgrades.desc: +10% coins from every breakable per level.

upgrades.name: Hatch Luck
upgrades.desc: +8% chance for Epic, Legendary and Mythic pets per level (multiplies their odds).

upgrades.name: Hatch Speed
upgrades.desc: Eggs hatch 6% faster per level (shorter cooldown between hatches).

unlocks.name: Auto Hatch
unlocks.desc: Automatically keep hatching the egg you are standing at. (Free with your first Rebirth.)

unlocks.name: Octo Hatch
unlocks.desc: Hatch 8 eggs at once. Requires Triple Hatch. (Free with your second Rebirth.)
